# NIST CAVP test vectors for the SP 800-56A finite-field Diffie-Hellman
# primitive: the KAS FFC "dhEphem" validity test, DLC primitive only (Z, no
# KDF), initiator role.
#
# Source archive: https://csrc.nist.gov/CSRC/media/Projects/Cryptographic-Algorithm-Validation-Program/documents/keymgmt/KASTestVectorsFFC2016.zip
#   retrieved 2026-09-15, SHA-256 d47b07fbd95cabe72eee796f55dec67d5c111e29b8731293c2f6332366b2fb78
#   linked from https://csrc.nist.gov/Projects/Cryptographic-Algorithm-Validation-Program/Key-Establishment
# File copied from it, complete:
#   KASTestVectorsFFC2016/Test of 800-56A excluding KDF/FFC Ephemeral Scheme/
#   KASValidityTest_FFCEphem_NOKC_ZZOnly_init.fax  SHA-256 adedac7e6f1447f7b57e2041c86c6955bbf32d74dc389a52cf9656aae4b7102d
#
# Per parameter set ([FB - SHA512]: L = 2048, N = 224; [FC - SHA512]: L =
# 2048, N = 256) the file gives a domain P, Q, G and 24 records: the CAVS
# ephemeral key pair XephemCAVS, YephemCAVS, the IUT ephemeral key pair
# XephemIUT, YephemIUT, the shared secret Z = YephemCAVS^XephemIUT mod P as
# the SP 800-56A Appendix C.1 byte string (as long as P), CAVSHashZZ =
# SHA-512(Z), and Result. Result = P is a correct Z ("10 - Z value should
# have leading 0 nibble" is a correct Z whose first byte is below 0x10);
# Result = F (2 - ...) is a YephemCAVS that fails the public-key validation of
# §5.6.2.3.1 (the old numbering's 5.6.2.4), so no Z may be computed; Result =
# F (5 - Z changed) is a Z the primitive does not produce. The bracketed
# lines [FB], [FC] and [SHA(s) supported ...] in the CAVS header at the top of
# the file describe the file and carry no records.
#
# Records are verbatim; only carriage returns were removed and runs of blank
# lines collapsed to one. Lines starting with # are provenance comments, not
# part of the CAVP file (its own header lines also start with # and are
# kept).
